title: कक्षा दशको नेपाली पाठ्यक्रम (२०७१) को विश्लेषण {Analysis of Class Ten Nepali Syllabus (2071)}
nepali: प्रस्तुत ‘कक्षा १० को नेपाली पाठ्यक्रम (२०७१) को विश्लेषण’ शीर्षकको आलेख भाषापाठ्यक्रमको धारणा स्पष्ट पारी पाठ्यक्रम निर्माण प्रक्रियाको चर्चा गर्दै प्रकारगत आधारमा कक्षा १० को नेपाली पाठ्यक्रम (२०७१) को विश्लेषण गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार पारिएको हो । यो अध्ययन मूलतः गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको भएकाले पुस्तकालय पद्धतिको उपयोग गरी सङ्कलित प्राथमिक र द्वितीयक स्रोतका सामग्रीको अध्ययन विश्लेषणबाट प्राप्त तथ्यलाई तर्क र प्रमाणका आधारमा पुष्टि गरिएको छ । भाषिक सिप आर्जनका निम्ति तयार पारिएको योजनाबद्ध दस्तावेजलाई भाषापाठ्यक्रम भनिन्छ । पाठ्यक्रम निर्माणका सन्दर्भमा आवश्यकताको पहिचान, लक्ष्य र उद्देश्यको निर्धारण, पाठ्यवस्तुको निर्धारण र प्रस्तुतिक्रम, शिक्षण प्रक्रिया, मूल्याङ्कन प्रक्रिया अपनाइन्छ । कक्षा १० को नेपाली पाठ्यक्रमलाई दृष्टिगत गर्दा सम्प्रेषणात्मक एवम् रचनामुखी, भाषिक सिपमा आधारित चक्रिय पद्धति, सक्षमतामा आधारित एवम् संरचनात्मक पाठ्यक्रमका रुपमा लिन सकिन्छ । यति भएर पनि परम्परागत पाठ्यक्रमबाट मुक्त हुन नसक्नु, क्रमबद्धताको अभाव,पुनरावृतिजस्ता सीमाहरु नेपाली पाठ्यक्रममा देखिन्छन् ।
american_english: The present article, titled “Analysis of Class 10 Nepali Curriculum (2071),” was prepared with the objective of clarifying the concept of a language curriculum, discussing the curriculum development process, and analyzing the Class 10 Nepali curriculum (2071) on a typological basis. Since this study is primarily qualitative in nature, facts obtained from studying and analyzing materials from primary and secondary sources collected using the library method have been corroborated on the basis of logic and evidence. A planned document prepared for the acquisition of language skills is called a language curriculum. In curriculum design, identifying needs, determining goals and objectives, selecting course content and presentation sequence, instructional procedures, and assessment procedures are adopted. When examining the Class 10 Nepali curriculum, it can be regarded as a communicative and creative, language-skill-based cyclical system, competency-based, and structural curriculum. Even so, limitations such as an inability to break free from traditional curricula, a lack of sequential progression, and repetition are evident in the Nepali curriculum.

informal_english: This paper, “Analysis of Class 10 Nepali Curriculum (2071)”, was put together to unpack what a language syllabus actually is, walk through how curricula get built, and break down the Class 10 Nepali curriculum (2071) by type. It’s basically qualitative research, so all the findings pulled from digging through primary and secondary library sources are backed up with solid reasoning and proof. A language curriculum is simply a planned-out document made to help folks pick up language skills. When putting a curriculum together, you sort out what's needed, nail down aims and goals, figure out the content and what order to teach it in, and line up the teaching and assessment methods. Looking over the Class 10 Nepali curriculum, you can see it's communicative and creative, uses a cyclic approach built around language skills, and works as a competency-based structural curriculum. That said, it’s still held back by old habits—it hasn't shaken off traditional syllabus models, lacks decent flow, and has too much repetition.
